messages:
nina_sales: Handoff: Aurora Labs pilot (AL-PILOT-2). 2-week pilot starts Mon. Asks: SAML SSO, private VPC peering, dedicated pool ~35 qps, embeddings for chart search + dedup. Main contact: jordan@auroralabs.ai. Renewal signal: high if p95 latency < 125ms and embed cost < $0.00046/token.
sam_csm: Thanks Nina. Quick Q: who owns peering vs. ingestion mapping?
nina_sales: Leo (infra) will provision peering and reserved pool; CS will handle data mapping and test payloads. We requested a handover Thu 9:30am PT.
leo_infra: Got it. I'll open INF-9102 for reserved pool + static egress IPs in us-west-2. Note: customer firewall requires approved IP list and maintenance window. Recommend prewarm to reduce tail latency.
anya_support: Support rota: @anya_support weekdays 8-6 PT. I'll create SUP-6307 and a private channel #aurora-support. Need runbook link and escalation path.
nina_sales: Runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurora (internal). Security questionnaire in Drive.
sam_csm: Action items: 1) schedule Thu 9:30 handover (owner: nina_sales) 2) CS onboarding plan (owner: sam_csm) 3) INF-9102 follow-up (owner: leo_infra) 4) SAML metadata exchange (owner: jordan@auroralabs / sam_csm). Add SLA/renewal notes?
leo_infra: INF-9102 ETA: provisioned by Wed if peering approved. We'll use quant profile q4_8 to meet cost targets; small accuracy delta possible  please capture eval prompts.
sam_csm: I'll run evals on q4_8 pre-launch. Need 10 customer-priority prompts to validate dedupe + retrieval  @nina_sales can you get them?
nina_sales: Jordan said they'll share prompts by Tue AM.
anya_support: Support prep: SUP-6307 created, #aurora-support created. Monitoring thresholds: avg latency > 140ms or error rate > 1.5% will page. I'll add warmup steps to the runbook.
infra-bot: infra-bot: INF-9102 created and assigned to leo_infra.
sam_csm: Risk register: renewal risk = medium-high. Tech risks: peering delay, KV cache warmup, quantization regressions. Ops risk: activation slipping beyond pilot window.
nina_sales: Sales note: focus on embedding unit economics; ask Aurora to track cost per search weekly.
sam_csm: Weekly sync Fri 11am PT; invite sent to Jordan + internal owners. I'll create feedback doc and regression tracker: https://redwood.internal/ops/aurora-feedback.
leo_infra: Prewarm example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prewarm -d '{"model":"embed-pro-lite","qps":35}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'  run in maintenance window to populate KV cache.
anya_support: Confirm owners and next steps?
sam_csm: Owners: CS onboarding = sam_csm; infra provisioning = leo_infra; support lead = anya_support; sales follow-ups = nina_sales. Next steps: 1) nina to collect prompts by Tue AM, 2) leo to update INF-9102 with IPs by Wed, 3) sam to publish onboarding plan by Wed EOD, 4) anya to post runbook and enable alerts.
anya_support: Confirmed. I'll enable PagerDuty for SUP-6307 and run an initial monitor at 8:30am PT on pilot start day.
nina_sales: Thanks all 44d I'll host Thur handover and include Aurora infra.
sam_csm: Thanks everyone 64c I'll prep eval harness and feedback doc ahead of handover.
